domain_title: Accountability, evidence, risk decisions and lifecycle governance
title: Risk inventory without risk control
canonical_definition: Risks are listed but not operationally treated, tested, reassessed or accepted by the correct authority.

conditions: All AI systems; rigor scales with impact and transition.
Record the assessed release, operating scope and evidence that supports any applicability decision.

primary_questions.question: Does the case exhibit Risk inventory without risk control: Risks are listed but not operationally treated, tested, reassessed or accepted by the correct authority.
Do implemented workflows, data paths or operations show generic risk lists, intended-only mitigations, or expired exceptions remaining active?
Does current evidence test presence or scoped absence of Risk inventory without risk control, or does it remain unknown?

conditions: Refer verified risk inventory without risk control to the accountable authority before progression where the condition materially affects the requested operating scope.

normative_source_mappings.relevant_locator: NIST AI 100-1, MAP 1.5 (PDF p. 31), MANAGE 1.2 (PDF p. 37), MANAGE 1.3 (PDF p. 37), MANAGE 1.4 (PDF p. 37)
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: The voluntary framework provides guidance on defining risk tolerance, prioritizing treatment and documenting residual risk. The SAE criteria define the object-specific rules. Confirm any binding obligation through the accountable authority and its applicable source.

failure_mechanism: The declared or implemented control can be unreliable where generic risk entries lack treatment, accountable owner or an explicit acceptance decision. The mechanism can have an operational effect where a material risk remains exposed because mitigation is unimplemented, ineffective or covered only by an expired exception.
potential_consequences: Known exposures can remain above tolerance without authorized treatment or acceptance.

atomic_tests.test: Compare the effective governance and design records. Determine whether generic risk entries lack treatment, accountable owner or an explicit acceptance decision. Identify the system scope and the record that supports each conclusion.

Trace actual configurations or activity for the assessed release. Determine whether a material risk remains exposed because mitigation is unimplemented, ineffective or covered only by an expired exception. Attribute each observation to the specific path, time and decision.

Independently review trace material and sampled accepted risks through implementation, effectiveness, expiry and authorization. Record whether each material mechanism was tested, the observed result and the scope limitations.

required_evidence.title: Effective design and governance records
required_evidence.description: Review the versioned owner decision and relevant specifications for evidence of whether generic risk entries lack treatment, accountable owner or an explicit acceptance decision. Preserve material conflict and applicability context.

required_evidence.title: Observed condition or enforcement trace
required_evidence.description: Use effective configuration or dated operational records to determine whether a material risk remains exposed because mitigation is unimplemented, ineffective or covered only by an expired exception. Identify the version, affected paths and period represented.

required_evidence.title: Executed scoped comparison
required_evidence.description: Provide trace material and sampled accepted risks through implementation, effectiveness, expiry and authorization. Include current scope, expected results, observed results, retained evidence and unresolved cases.

required_evidence.title: Independent review and limitations
required_evidence.description: An independent reviewer confirms the assessed version, completeness of coverage, result, limitations and whether a material change requires a new test.

required_artifacts: Trace material and sampled accepted risks through implementation, effectiveness, expiry and authorization.
Current version and scope with all material failure paths and cases identified.
Expected and observed results, attributable records, and independent review of coverage and residual limitations.

sufficiency: Presence requires affirmative evidence for a material mechanism. Examine whether generic risk entries lack treatment, accountable owner or an explicit acceptance decision, and separately check whether a material risk remains exposed because mitigation is unimplemented, ineffective or covered only by an expired exception. A supported mechanism may establish presence within its evidenced scope.
Keep unresolved or contradictory mechanisms UNKNOWN and preserve the competing records. Refer material interpretation conflicts to the accountable human authority.

Use TESTED_ABSENT only after a current, executed, successful and independently verified evaluation covers all material paths within scope. Use trace material and sampled accepted risks through implementation, effectiveness, expiry and authorization. Reassess when material changes affect that scope.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: A document can identify a declared gap. Effective configuration can demonstrate a reachable condition. Observed records support only their covered period and workflow. TESTED_ABSENT requires the complete scoped absence contract.
false_positive_guards: Time-limited risk acceptance can be valid where scope, expiry, limits and authorized decision are evidenced.
Confirm that the observed or alleged condition applies to the current assessed release and a reachable path.
prohibited_inferences: A gap or UNKNOWN in F3 alone cannot establish AP-F3 presence.
Missing complaints, incident silence and unsuccessful collection cannot establish absence.
Model output and tactic selection grant no authority to approve, close a finding or accept risk.

finding_definitions.title: Design or intent shows risk inventory without risk control
Implementation or operating evidence shows risk inventory without risk control
Presence or tested absence of risk inventory without risk control is unresolved within scope
